data.name: LUMINOVA
data.detailed_description:
Story
Embark on an adventure in a mysterious village full of secrets. As the main character, Haru, you will explore every corner, uncover the hidden truths behind enigmatic monsters, and challenge yourself to reveal the ultimate mystery at the heart of the village.

Character Progression
Experience a unique growth system where, instead of simply passing time, you wield a clock as your weapon. Harness the flow of time actively in combat and interactions, feeling a new dimension of progression through innovative gameplay.

Goal
You are deployed as an undercover agent tasked with discovering the enormous secret hidden within the village. Follow the story, track down scattered clues and numerous events, and ultimately confront the truth that awaits at the end of your journey.

Game Mechanics
Utilize various customized weapons suited to each monster’s traits, enjoying dynamic and exhilarating action. Strategic weapon choices and impactful controls lie at the core of the game’s fun.

Playtime
Designed as a graduation project, the game offers a relatively short playtime—making it easy to try and enjoy in a single session.

Genre
This game is an action adventure RPG, blending fast-paced action, exploration, collection, and progression for a thrilling and immersive experience
